Resolves #19388

ADR 0038's credential-class ledger gains row 7, the Fleet's observe read. Each seat's open work is read with **that seat's own** PAT from the Fleet's store, never the launching process's `GH_TOKEN` by default. Coverage is `partial` when some seats read and others' PAT is missing or refused. When no seat reads, it is `stale` over the last snapshot, or `unavailable` without one. Every affected seat is named with its next step.

Row 3 now declares what neomjs/neo-agent-brain#818 ships under the operator's one-PAT ruling. In normal setup one seat PAT serves classes 3, 4 and 7, a declared reuse, never a silent one. An existing plane binding or explicit tenant credential keeps its own authority as class 3. §4 records the two rejected alternatives.

The architecture guide that teaches the ledger moves with it: the count, the one-PAT prose, and a class-7 arrow marked as accepted and pending neomjs/neo-agent-brain#823. This is the ADR half of #823 (FM v1 row 4, gap 3), whose AC-1 needs it merged before the Brain implementation PR opens.

Evidence: L1 (docs-only; the edited Mermaid diagram rendered in its portal route) → L1 required (all four ACs are decision text; AC-4 is this PR's review).
